annotations.title: Read what a workspace tracks today

description: Read the workspace's canonical tracked-item total and breakdown: one item per search in one market on one platform, hashtag or account, counted once however many groups include it, with paused items separate. Use this total whenever you state how many searches, hashtags or accounts are tracked; do not add up group item counts or count a page of list results. Pass includeItems for each item's platform, market, frequency, last and next collection, latest refresh outcome and Monitor report inclusion. Reads stored evidence/configuration; no provider collection or collection charge. Preserve returned timestamps, coverage, missing evidence and errors. Synchronous; no polling unless the result explicitly supplies continuation.

workspaceId.description: Reuse the authorized default or sole accessible workspace when omitted.
